about_p1: We provide moving services for private individuals and institutions in Bielsko-Biała and throughout Poland.
about_p2: Our company has been operating since 1997, gaining extensive experience in the moving industry.
fleet_text: We use dedicated moving trucks, including a truck fitted with a 750 kg liftgate. This allows us to safely and efficiently transport even heavy furniture and equipment.
pricing_p1: We offer transparent and fair pricing. We prepare an exact quote after learning all the details of the job – loading and unloading addresses, the number and weight of items to be transported.
pricing_p2: Based on this, we determine the required number of vehicles and workers, and the expected completion time, so you only pay for what you truly need.
services_1_desc: We provide support and professional advice at every stage of your move. That’s why moving with us is simple.
services_2_desc: We also take care of removing old furniture, household appliances, and electronics. If after your move there’s something you’d like to get rid of, we’ll handle it for you!
services_3_desc: If you’re looking for a reliable team to make your company move easier, you’ve come to the right place. Office relocations are our specialty.
services_4_desc: Need a spacious vehicle for your move? Give us a call! We offer vehicle rentals with a driver included.
services_5_desc: Beyond moving, our team can also disassemble and reassemble your household or office furniture.

about_us_intro: We are a team with many years of experience in moving services, operating in Bielsko-Biała and throughout Poland.
about_us_story_p1: Our company was born from a passion for helping people during important moments in their lives. We noticed that moving, while exciting, often comes with stress and logistical challenges. We decided to change this experience by offering comprehensive assistance that relieves our clients from the most difficult aspects of relocation.
about_us_story_p2: Over the years, we have developed our services, investing in modern equipment, employee training, and expanding our reach. Today, we can proudly say that we are trusted partners to hundreds of families and companies throughout Poland.
value_reliability_desc: We keep deadlines and promises. We treat every move with the utmost care, ensuring the safety of the property entrusted to us.
value_professionalism_desc: Our employees undergo regular training and have specialized equipment. This allows us to carry out every move efficiently and effectively.
value_care_desc: We understand the emotional aspect of moving. We treat our clients' belongings with the same attention as our own, ensuring their maximum safety.
about_us_expertise_p1: We specialize in various types of moves, from small apartments to large single-family homes and commercial premises. Our vehicle fleet is adapted to diverse needs, allowing us to efficiently manage even the most demanding orders.
process_step1_desc: We offer free, transparent quotes online or during an on-site visit. We consider all factors to ensure the price is fair and final.
process_step2_desc: We create a detailed moving plan, taking into account the specifics of items, property access, and preferred timing.
process_step3_desc: Our experienced staff safely pack, transport, and unload all items, paying attention to every detail.
process_step4_desc: After completing the move, we check customer satisfaction and offer after-sales support.
about_us_team_desc: Our employees are qualified specialists with years of experience in the moving industry. Every team member undergoes training in safe packing, transportation, and operation of specialized equipment. This allows us to guarantee the highest quality of service.
about_us_commitment_p1: We are proud of our work and the relationships we build with our clients. Many of them return to us for subsequent moves or recommend us to their friends - this is our greatest honor.
about_us_commitment_p2: We continuously develop, introducing new solutions and improvements to make each subsequent move even better than the previous one.
about_us_end: Trust us, and your move will proceed smoothly and professionally.
